items.title: Joseph Rene and Edna Kelly Interview, 1969-12-15
items.q: I played there five years... I played from 35 up to 42 I played there with a fella that's called Rap... And young, you call him Spook. And handy, played the bass.

ctx.x: I know where you, on Ivyville. Yeah, that's right. I played there five years. I played from, oh, I retired. I played from 35 up to 42. 35 up to 42 I played there with a fella that's called Rap. I don't know if you've already talked about him. Played guitar. Rap, yeah, that's right. And young, you call him Spook. And handy, played the bass. And Decaugé, you might have heard him talk about him. I would have been playing the write-up about him. Decaugé. No, I don't think I know.
No? That was a wonderful piano player.
